last_legacy_target_evidence.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('Vero_Refine_Finalise_R.thy');s=p.read_text();pat=r'(\\(\\* VERO START c0065 prove \\*\\))(.*?)(\\(\\* VERO END c0065 prove \\*\\))'
def f(m):
 b=m[2].replace('irq_state_relation_def ','').replace('; simp add: fun_upd_apply','')
 return m[1]+'\\nproof -\\n  have [simp]: \"irq_state_relation irq_state.IRQInactive irqstate.IRQInactive\" by (simp add: irq_state_relation_def)\\n  show ?thesis\\n'+b+'qed\\n'+m[3]
s=re.sub(pat,f,s,flags=re.S);p.write_text(s)
p=Path('Vero_Refine_InterruptAcc_R.thy');s=p.read_text();pat=r'(\\(\\* VERO START c0076 prove \\*\\))(.*?)(\\(\\* VERO END c0076 prove \\*\\))'
def f(m):
 b=m[2].replace(\"by (cases state; cases state'; auto\",'by (auto').replace('irq_state_relation_def ','').replace('; simp add: fun_upd_apply','')
 return m[1]+r'''
proof -
  assume r: \"irq_state_relation state state'\"
  have eq: \"(state = irq_state.IRQInactive) = (state' = irqstate.IRQInactive)\"
    using r by (cases state; cases state'; simp add: irq_state_relation_def)
  show ?thesis using r eq
'''+b+'qed\\n'+m[3]
s=re.sub(pat,f,s,flags=re.S);p.write_text(s)
PY"
